High Voltage

High Voltage are a high-energy rock & pop band with killer vocals, epic party vibes, and over 100 crowd-pleasing hits to ignite your dance floor.

About High Voltage

High Voltage are a powerhouse 4-piece band delivering rock and pop party anthems guaranteed to get your guests dancing, singing, and rocking out. With explosive vocals, guitars, bass, and drums, they bring high-octane energy and slick musicianship to every event. All four members trained at the British Institute of Modern Music and have shared stages with artists like Royal Blood, George Ezra, Emeli Sande, and Olly Murs. Between them, they’ve played iconic venues like the Roundhouse, Jazz Cafe, and Islington O2, and performed at festivals like Glastonbury, SXSW, Notting Hill Carnival, and Newquay Beach Break. Their 100+ song repertoire spans decades of rock, pop, indie, and party classics, and you’re welcome to hand-pick your favourites. The band will learn a special request for free and keep communication smooth and responsive from start to finish. They come fully equipped with PA, lighting, and even inflatable instruments to unleash your inner rock star — plus bonus party tricks like accent battles and levitating cans! High Voltage – Always Ready To Rock. Enquire now!
